notes: Calls MurmurHash3(input) without new, which resets and reuses one module-level hasher instead of allocating one per call. This is the documented fast path; every key is still hashed in full.
details: Calls MurmurHash3(input) without new, which resets and reuses one module-level hasher object instead of allocating one per call. This is the package's documented fast path; every key is still hashed in full and no result is cached.
